verdict.rationale: Lambda has no first-party natural-language interface; its docs cover only a console, SSH/JupyterLab and a REST Cloud API with an OpenAPI spec. The only natural-language path is an unofficial, community-built CLI and MCP server that lets AI agents find, launch and terminate Lambda GPU instances from commands like 'launch an H100, ssh in, run a job', built on that public API. Missing for 10: a first-party natural-language or agent interface, an official MCP server, AI-readable docs (llms.txt returns 404), and independent hands-on corroboration that the unofficial tool works reliably.
